title: Work attribution and capture close cleanly
goal: The orchestrator's claim windows close after land, so a non-worker session is attributed to no item; SessionEnd's launch marks its own session before the missed-SessionEnd catch-up and reads its own transcript, not the first glob hit; and backlog.py cost gives the work figures of an item done in an earlier session of its sprint, or names why it has none
